item.description:
Premium Cod Fish Steak 500g
Enjoy premium seafood at home with SilverSea Premium Cod Fish Steak. Made from Patagonian Toothfish, this wild-caught fish is known for its rich flavour, buttery taste and tender texture.

Conveniently portioned into fish steaks, it is ideal for preparing delicious seafood meals for the whole family. Whether steamed with ginger and soy sauce, pan-fried until golden, baked or grilled, it offers a versatile option for everyday dining.

Product Highlights

🐟 Premium Patagonian Toothfish
Enjoy the rich flavour and naturally tender texture of this premium fish.

🌊 Wild-Caught Seafood
A delicious seafood choice for a variety of home-cooked meals.

🍽️ Versatile Cooking Options
Suitable for steaming, pan-frying, baking, grilling and air frying.

📦 Individually Wrapped
Convenient packaging for easy handling and storage.

💪 A Source of Protein
Fish provides protein as part of a balanced diet.

💙 Rich in Omega-3
Contains omega-3 fatty acids, including EPA and DHA, as part of a balanced diet.

💪 High in Protein
Provides protein to support muscle growth and maintenance.

Product Details
Product Name: Premium Cod Fish Steak
Fish Species: Patagonian Toothfish
Net Weight: 1kg/500g/200-220g
Catch Method: Wild-caught
Origin: Antarctic Ocean
Ingredients: Cod Fish, Water
Packaging: Individually wrapped
Size & Shape: Individual pieces may vary in size and shape. Packs may include tail portions.
Bone Information: This is a bone-in fish steak and may contain large bones and pin bones. Please check carefully before preparation and consumption.
Storage Instructions

❄️ Keep Frozen.
Keep frozen until ready to use. Thaw safely in the refrigerator before cooking and follow the instructions on the product packaging.
Serving Suggestion

For a simple and delicious meal, steam the fish with ginger, spring onion and light soy sauce. Alternatively, pan-fry, bake or grill with your favourite seasonings and serve with vegetables or rice.


🥘DEFROST METHOD
1. Place fish in the fridge (0-20°C) for 3-5 hours.
2. Remove fish from vacuum bag.
3. For best result, soak the fish in a cold brine for 30-45 minutes.
4. Remove fish from the brine. Pat it dry with a paper towel.

🍲BRINE PREPARATION
1. Ingredients: 1 litre cold water, 30g salt and 15g sugar.
2. Mix salt and sugar with a little bit of warm water until both salt and sugar are dissolved. 
3. Mix it in the cold water.

Cooking Suggestions
🧈 Pan-Seared Butter Cod Steak (Recommended)
Thaw overnight in the refrigerator.
Pat the fish dry and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat butter and olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook for 4–5 minutes per side, depending on thickness.
Add garlic, thyme, and lemon during the final minute.
Serve immediately with your favourite sides.

🔥 Oven Baked Herb Cod
Preheat oven to 200°C.
Season with butter, garlic, rosemary, and lemon.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the fish flakes easily.

🍳 Air Fryer
Preheat to 190°C.
Brush lightly with olive oil.
Air fry for 10–12 minutes, turning once halfway through if needed.

🥢 Chinese-Style Steamed Cod
Top with ginger, spring onion, and a few slices of red chilli.
Steam for 8–10 minutes.
Finish with light soy sauce and hot oil for a fragrant, authentic flavour.
Serving Suggestions

🍚 Steamed Rice
🥔 Mashed Potatoes
🥦 Steamed Broccoli
🥗 Fresh Garden Salad
🥕 Roasted Vegetables
🍋 Lemon Wedges
🧄 Garlic Butter Sauce
🍄 Creamy Mushroom Sauce
